equations.label: White Eq. (6.117) compressible flowmeter expansion-factor correction
equations.quote: The dimensionless _expansion factor Y_ is a function of pressure ratio, _β_, and
assumptions: Differential-pressure orifice/nozzle/venturi flowmeter construction with upstream density; expansion factor is meter-type dependent
validity: Y depends on pressure ratio, diameter ratio beta and meter type; not a universal choked injector formula
equations.description: White PDF p750; retain distinction from isentropic subsonic/choked injector mass flux.
equations.extraction_note: Docling visually located formula stage executed; original-PDF expression checked directly. Source numerator contains rho_1; beta=d/D. Source Y curves distinguish sharp-edged orifices from nozzles/venturis. No empirical Y curve digitization or universal Cd selection is asserted. SI units are dimensional interpretations.
